content.short: Truffle Verify is a Solidity-based plugin that verifies source code deployed on the Ethereum blockchain.
content.description: Truffle Verify is a plugin designed to work with code developed on the Truffle development framework. After deployment, it simplifies the process of manually adding constructor parameters and flattening the contract into a single, readable representation. This clearer presentation of the verified code helps users understand exactly what the contract does and how it behaves, reducing ambiguity for auditors and end-users alike, thereby promoting transparency and strengthening security in verified deployments.
content.meta: Truffle Verify verifies Solidity source code deployed on Ethereum. Discover Truffle Verify and other Web3 Developer Tools on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
